proposed_rules.trigger: A recurring full-width footer zone at the bottom of nearly every page: a fixed marketing tagline ('The best no-code platform for...') followed by a thin row whose only rendered text is pipe separators ('| |'), indicating a collapsed footer link list.
proposed_rules.decision: Treat as global site-wide footer chrome, excluded from the page's own block inventory (model as a shared fragment, same treatment as nav/cookie overlay). Flag the '| |' row for Phase 2 to recover the actual footer link labels.
proposed_rules.rationale: Identical structure recurs unchanged across every sampled page, matching the existing site-chrome precedent. Rejected alternative: model it as a page-level 'cta' block, but content is byte-identical across pages so it is chrome, not authored content.
